summary: Antares Strategic Credit Fund II LLC filed an 8-K announcing a regular and special distribution of $0.1784 per share total net distribution, payable on July 30, 2026, to shareholders of record June 30, 2026. The filing also discloses a continuous private placement of common shares, noting receipt of ~$2.5M in subscriptions in June 2026, and provides a NAV per share of $24.80 as of May 31, 2026, aggregate NAV of ~$79.1M, and debt-to-equity ratio of 1.10x. This is a routine dividend declaration and NAV update with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or activist campaign.
